core_finding: Pilot V3 increases narrative complexity but receiver-visible fixture text directly names or strongly telegraphs the discriminating relation and, in several items, the intended disposition. This risks lexical cueing / answer leakage and does not cleanly test whether the treatment supplies the relation.

examples: PILOT-V3-01 header names Observability vs State Conflation and Independent Restored Identifiability
PILOT-V3-02 header names Unidentifiability & Necessary Abstention and the scenario states the sensor has zero mathematical rank
PILOT-V3-03 header names Finite Admissibility, Quotient Stage Erasure, Collapsing Distinct Support Fibres
PILOT-V3-04 header names Receiver-Relative Continuity and Mandatory Predecessor Head Chaining
PILOT-V3-05 header names Chronology, Preemption & Non-Retroactivity and Authorized Positive Preemption Gap
defects.consequence: The receiver can infer the target relation from the stimulus itself.

examples: PILOT-V3-01 explicitly reports independent mathematical signature verification === true and valid HSM inclusion proof
PILOT-V3-02 explicitly states two causes yield identical observation and orthogonal discriminating diagnostic has not run
PILOT-V3-03 explicitly states RESYNC_SNAPSHOT is only physically supported on standby and was executed on primary causing transaction abort / dirty-page eviction
PILOT-V3-04 explicitly states the bridge did not bind Station 1 head_digest and shows predecessor_head_digest all-zero
PILOT-V3-05 explicitly states prior mandate authorizes action, 170ms is within 500ms, timestamps are faithfully preserved, and no chronology laundering occurred
defects.consequence: Several items are likely answerable without the tested methodology, recreating ceiling risk.
K2/K3 may gain from treatment-to-stimulus vocabulary overlap rather than transfer of the underlying relation.

defects.finding: The completion report states or implies that only particular methodologies should succeed on several fixtures. That is a design hypothesis, not an earned prediction.
defects.consequence: Do not encode expected arm winners into the key, harness, manifest, or scoring rule.

repair_constraints: Do not execute any Pilot V3 receiver calls from commit 06eb4187....
Create receiver-clean field-primary fixtures with no cluster/construct/answer-bearing headers in the dispatched bytes.
Keep cluster/construct metadata outside receiver context in the manifest only.
Use field-native wording rather than TD613/Aperture keywords wherever the tested relation can be expressed without them.
Make the decisive relation inferable from evidence structure, not stated as a theorem in the scenario.
Do not encode expected arm ordering or winners.
Recommit a fresh offline pilot key because receiver-visible fixture bytes change.
